properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Real EC private key (P-256/secp256r1, 'BEGIN EC PRIVATE KEY') committed in crates/sdk/src/network/grpc.rs as TEST_KEY, paired with a self-signed 'sp1-sdk-mtls-test' certificate; used only in #[cfg(test)] module to exercise the mTLS gRPC path. Hardcoded key material, test fixture, not a production secret — but genuine committed key material in source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: md-5 crate is a declared (transitive) dependency in Cargo.lock — the build ships an MD5 implementation. Classically broken (collision) hash; no direct call site pinned in application code. Dependency inventory entry.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: sha1 crate declared in Cargo.lock — the build ships a SHA-1 implementation (transitive). No direct call site pinned in application code. Dependency inventory entry.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: secp256k1 elliptic-curve arithmetic exposed as zkVM precompiles (RiscvAirId::Secp256k1AddAssign / Secp256k1DoubleAssign and user variants) so guest programs — Ethereum-style ECDSA — can prove curve operations inside SP1. 640 sites across executor/precompile implementations and artifacts. Shor-vulnerable curve; changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Committed RSA-2048/3072/4096 keypairs in DER (including e=17 public-exponent variants) under examples/rsa/script/src/ — fixtures for the RSA-in-zkVM example. Real hardcoded key material, test-only, not production secrets. RSA is Shor-vulnerable; changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Digest-equality gates in SP1 verifier code (sp1_vk_digest vs vkey_hash, public-values SHA-256/BLAKE3 hashes, groth16/plonk vkey hashes) implemented with non-constant-time `!=` on public data. Both operands are public (proof-supplied vs published vk hashes), so this is not a secret-dependent MAC comparison — kept as a posture note, not a practical timing side channel.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: RSA usage across the RSA zkVM example and a vendored crypto library: examples/rsa/script/src/main.rs loads committed RSA-2048/3072/4096 PKCS#8 DER keypairs (incl. e=17 variants) and runs RSA operations inside the SP1 zkVM via the RustCrypto rsa crate; patch-testing/RustCrypto-rsa is a locally patched, vendored copy of the RustCrypto RSA crate (shipped API surface; keygen call at lib.rs:40); rsa also declared in examples/Cargo.lock. Shor-vulnerable; changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ECDSA-over-secp256k1 crate(s) declared in Cargo.lock — the build ships Shor-vulnerable ECDSA (migration: ML-DSA-65). Dependency inventory entry; presence recorded even without a pinned call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: secp256r1 (P-256) precompile support in the SP1 zkVM executor (RiscvAirId::Secp256r1AddAssign / Secp256r1AddAssignUser / Secp256r1DoubleAssign) — real curve arithmetic exposed to guest programs (NIST P-256 / ECDSA use cases). 546 sites across executor and artifacts. Shor-vulnerable curve; changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 Edwards curve arithmetic implemented inside the zkVM executor (ed25519_sqrt hook, ED_ADD syscall → edwards_add, Ed25519BaseField modulus) — EdDSA support for guest programs. 521 sites. Shor-vulnerable signature scheme; changeable here (migration: ML-DSA-65).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ECDSA (secp256k1 via k256) in live use: crates/sdk/src/network/tee/mod.rs recovers TEE-proof signers with k256::ecdsa (Signature::from_bytes, RecoveryId, VerifyingKey::recover_from_prehash) — Ethereum-style ECDSA verification of TEE attestations; plus sp1-zkvm's default 'ecdsa' feature (dep:elliptic-curve) exposing ECDSA to guest programs. Shor-vulnerable; migration ML-DSA-65; changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: curve25519-dalek (Curve25519/Edwards) declared in workspace Cargo.toml and used for Edwards point decompression precompiles in the executor — this is Ed25519 point handling, not X25519 key agreement; no Curve25519 ECDH found at these sites. Kept as the Curve25519-family dependency + precompile surface (Shor-vulnerable family).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Generic ECDH API re-exported to zkVM guest programs: sp1-zkvm lib's 'ecdh' Cargo feature exposes elliptic_curve::ecdh::{diffie_hellman, EphementSecret, SharedSecret} (crates/zkvm/lib/src/ecdsa.rs) for guest programs running k256/p256 curves. Real key-agreement surface; Shor-vulnerable (migration: ML-KEM-768); changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ed25519-dalek declared in Cargo.lock and crates/test-artifacts/programs/Cargo.lock — dependency inventory; Ed25519 is Shor-vulnerable (migration: ML-DSA-65). The zkVM executor also implements Ed25519 arithmetic directly (see ALG-5e08bdf5).

properties.name: pqs:context

properties.value: AWS KMS as remote transaction-signing infrastructure in sp1-sdk's network signer (alloy_signer_aws / aws_sdk_kms): signs with keys held in KMS (ECC secp256k1 / ECDSA per AWS-alloy defaults). Keys unreachable here; algorithm support decided by the AWS service (observable here, replaceable only by the vendor); the SDK choice of backend is changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ring 0.17.14 installed as rustls's DEFAULT crypto provider for the SDK's network stack: crates/sdk/src/network/client.rs:191 calls rustls::crypto::ring::default_provider().install_default() in production code (and grpc.rs test module does the same). Consequence: the gRPC/HTTPS sessions to the network prover run TLS 1.3 over the ring provider, whose key-exchange groups are classical only (X25519/ECDHE) — no X25519MLKEM768, even though the PQ-capable aws-lc-rs 1.16.3 provider is already in the dep

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ed25519-dalek vendored under patch-testing/curve25519-dalek/src/lib.rs (locally patched copy of the dalek crates) and declared in crates/test-artifacts/programs/Cargo.lock — the patch-testing workspace overrides the upstream dependency with a local patched copy, which ships an Ed25519 implementation with the build. Shor-vulnerable EdDSA.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: rustls declared in crates/cli/Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock — the CLI's TLS stack; the SDK's gRPC TLS (tonic ClientTlsConfig in grpc.rs) also rides rustls defaults with webpki/enabled roots, no custom cipher-suite or named-group configuration anywhere in the workspace. Classical key exchange (ECDHE/X25519) by default — harvest-now-decrypt-later surface; PQ readiness depends on the locked rustls version/provider (aws-lc-rs adds X25519MLKEM768 in newer releases). Migration: hybrid X25519+ML-KEM-768.
